verdicts.title: Symplectic reduction of quasi-morphisms and quasi-states
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove that quasi-morphisms and quasi-states on a closed integral symplectic manifold descend under symplectic reduction to symplectic hyperplane sections. Along the way we show that quasi-morphisms that arise from spectral invariants are the Calabi homomorphism when restricted to Hamiltonians supported on stably displaceable sets.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'quasi-morphisms and quasi-states' descending under 'symplectic reduction to symplectic hyperplane sections,' with no mention of SAT formulas, clause complexity, or symplectic leaf orders in hyperkähler moduli spaces.

verdicts.title: Towards Generalizing Schubert Calculus in the Symplectic Category
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The main purpose of this article is to extend some of the ideas from Schubert calculus to the more general setting of Hamiltonian torus actions on compact symplectic manifolds with isolated fixed points. Given a generic component of the moment map, we define a canonical class α_p in the equivariant cohomology of the manifold M for each fixed point p of M.
